title: Component Vault — SQLite + FTS5 schema (8 layers)

storage_layout.note: PDF/STEP 等大檔存 blob_dir，DB 只存 sha256 與相對路徑；docker volume 掛載整個 vault_volume。

columns.canonical_key: TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE -- component_knowledge_key() 正規化結果，如 component:stm32f405rgt6
columns.mpn: TEXT NOT NULL -- 原樣 canonical MPN

columns.name: TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE -- 正規名
columns.aliases: TEXT -- JSON array of name variants

columns.component_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES components(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_alias_key ON component_aliases(alias_key, alias_type, COALESCE(distributor,''))

columns.sha256: TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE -- 去重鍵
columns.blob_path: TEXT NOT NULL -- 相對 vault_volume 的 blob 路徑
columns.provenance_detail: TEXT -- JSON：來源 URL/skill 名/policy gate 記錄

component_documents.comment: document↔MPN 多對多；一份 datasheet 涵蓋整個料號家族

columns.component_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES components(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.document_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES documents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.is_primary: INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- 該元件的主 datasheet

columns.document_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES documents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.anchor: TEXT -- JSON：座標/bbox/section path（EvidenceRef 錨點）
columns.content: TEXT NOT NULL -- 抽取文字；table 為正規化 TSV/JSON
columns.extractor: TEXT NOT NULL -- 抽取器名+版本，如 docxmcp@1.4
columns.stale: INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- 抽取器升級後舊 chunk 標 1，不刪除

indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_chunks_document ON chunks(document_id, stale)

chunks_fts.comment: FTS5 external-content 表，content 指向 chunks；BM25 排序
chunks_fts.ddl: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE chunks_fts USING fts5(content, content='chunks', content_rowid='id', tokenize='unicode61')

spec_values.comment: EAV 長表：任意類別元件規格；field_path 沿用 FIELD_ALIASES dotted 命名空間

columns.component_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES components(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.field_path: TEXT NOT NULL -- canonical dotted path，如 recommended_operating_conditions.vin_max_v
columns.value_text: TEXT -- 非數值規格；value_num/value_text 至少其一
columns.condition: TEXT -- 量測條件，如 'Iout=300mA, Tj=25C'；同 field 多值靠此區分
columns.source_note: TEXT -- 無 chunk 時的顯式來源說明
columns.confidence: TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(confidence IN ('verified','unverified')) DEFAULT 'unverified'

constraints: CHECK(value_num IS NOT NULL OR value_text IS NOT NULL OR min_val IS NOT NULL OR typ_val IS NOT NULL OR max_val IS NOT NULL)
-- 寫入層強制：confidence='verified' 需要 evidence_chunk_id 或 source_note 非空（trigger 實作）
triggers: CREATE TRIGGER trg_spec_verified_needs_evidence BEFORE INSERT ON spec_values WHEN NEW.confidence='verified' AND NEW.evidence_chunk_id IS NULL AND (NEW.source_note IS NULL OR NEW.source_note='') BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'verified spec requires evidence_chunk_id or source_note'); END
indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_spec_component_field ON spec_values(component_id, field_path)

packages.comment: 封裝定義；同元件多封裝變體

columns.component_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES components(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.land_pattern: TEXT -- JSON IPC land pattern 參數
columns.confidence: TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(confidence IN ('verified','unverified')) DEFAULT 'unverified'

indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_pkg ON packages(component_id, package_name)

columns.component_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES components(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.package_id: INTEGER REFERENCES packages(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.confidence: TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(confidence IN ('verified','unverified')) DEFAULT 'unverified'

indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_pins ON pins(component_id, COALESCE(package_id,0), pin_number)

columns.component_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES components(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.library_ref: TEXT NOT NULL -- 如 'Regulator_Linear:AP2112K-3.3' 或 footprint lib:name 或 STEP blob sha256
columns.verification_status: TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(verification_status IN ('unverified','pin-checked','drc-passed')) DEFAULT 'unverified'
columns.verified_in: TEXT -- JSON：{project_id, run_id, date} 驗證出處
columns.pin_map: TEXT -- JSON：symbol pin↔component pin 映射（需要時）

indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_eda_component ON eda_assets(component_id, asset_kind)

columns.component_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES components(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.title: TEXT NOT NULL
columns.payload: TEXT NOT NULL -- JSON：結構化內容（規則參數/IR 片段/必配料關係）
columns.companion_component_id: INTEGER REFERENCES components(id) -- knowledge_type=companion-part 時指向必配料
columns.confidence: TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(confidence IN ('verified','unverified')) DEFAULT 'unverified'

indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_appk_component ON app_knowledge(component_id, knowledge_type)

columns.component_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES components(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.resolved_by: TEXT -- 解掉此 gap 的寫入（audit_log id）

indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_gaps ON knowledge_gaps(component_id, resolved)

audit_log.comment: append-only；無任何 UPDATE/DELETE 路徑（trigger 強制）

columns.actor: TEXT NOT NULL -- agent/user/pipeline 識別
columns.evidence_ref: TEXT -- chunk id 或 source note

triggers: CREATE TRIGGER trg_audit_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON audit_log BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'audit_log is append-only'); END
CREATE TRIGGER trg_audit_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON audit_log BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'audit_log is append-only'); END

columns.component_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES components(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_usage ON usage(component_id, project_id)

sourcing_snapshots.comment: 時間戳快照，非即時；不做 live query

columns.component_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES components(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_sourcing ON sourcing_snapshots(component_id, distributor, snapshot_at DESC)

columns.component_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES components(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.substitute_component_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES components(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.confidence: TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(confidence IN ('verified','unverified')) DEFAULT 'unverified'

indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_subst ON substitutions(component_id, substitute_component_id)

derived_views.component_completeness: VIEW：per-component extraction score = 各層覆蓋度聚合（有 pinout? 有 package? 有 key electrical? 有 EDA asset? 有未解 gap?）
derived_views.knowledge_queue: VIEW：未解 gaps × 跨專案 occurrence 聚合 × priority 規則（取代 in-memory build_component_knowledge_queue）

field_path_namespace.comment: L4 field_path 的 canonical 命名空間，沿用既有 vault.py FIELD_ALIASES
field_path_namespace.alias_resolution: API 層解析 friendly alias（vcc_min_v→recommended_operating_conditions.vin_min_v）；DB 只存 canonical path
